name: Willowkeel
region_detail: A sheltered backwater along the Storbruhn, accessible from a lesser river landing.
site_type: boatyard | Inhabited locations | Independent riverside craft community and repair yard.
history: Several boatbuilding families established a repair yard beside a naturally sheltered backwater before the Edict of the East. Over time, reedworkers, caulkers, and other craftspeople joined them, using locally gathered materials to maintain the shallow-draft vessels employed throughout the region.
current_state: The community repairs skiffs, canoes, keelboats, and fishing equipment for independent boatmen and visitors of several ancestries. The shared landing and covered work areas operate according to customary arrangements among the residents. Business varies with the river’s seasonal conditions, but no immediate crisis threatens the yard.
inhabitants: Human and halfling boatbuilders, several Ssaresh reedworkers and their families, itinerant Namaris traders, and visiting boat crews.
danger_level: Low within the community; ordinary river hazards along the approach.
points_of_interest:
Sheltered landing; timber slipway; covered repair sheds; caulking hearth; racks of drying reeds; shared storehouse; small lodging house.

Unresolved elements: The names and relationships of the resident craftspeople; The extent of the yard’s capacity for larger or specialized vessels; Whether expanding commercial traffic changes its customary arrangements.
discovery: A sheltered backwater along the Storbruhn, accessible from a lesser river landing. Independent river captains know the yard and may recommend it to travelers requiring repairs, supplies, or shelter.

No established faction plots, quests, jobs, or rumors currently pertain to this location.

Notable individuals and factions: Independent residents of Willowkeel; Visiting boatmen, Ssaresh craftspeople, and Namaris traders.
